Deshi Dosh celebrates 21 February
2019-02-19T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/news/deshi-dosh-celebrates-21-february-1703914

Deshi Dosh is synonymous with the ten most popular boutiques, housed under one roof. The purpose it to promote the development of creativity, culture and heritage of local taant and weaving industries. The ten boutiques are- Nipun, Rang Bangladesh, Deshal, Banglar Mela, Bibiana, Sadakalo, Anjan's, Srishti, Nogordola and Kay Kraft.

For the month of February that embodies the philosophy of International Mother's Language Day, these boutiques have introduced their latest collection that is dominated by the colours black and white and accents of red. In addition to clothes, shoppers can also purchase different kinds of accessories, jewellery and home textile products.

These collections are available at all Deshi Dosh outlets in Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet, Bogura and Narayanganj.
